summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that, when a local `bun` binary is not found, downloads a pinned Bun runtime archive from oven-sh's GitHub releases, unpacks it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a bundled `math_init.js`. The `math_init.js` file is a single-line ~727KB heavily obfuscated script (obfuscator.io-style string-array rotator, hex-mangled identifiers, charset decoder) with no readable functionality. setup.mjs itself uses obfuscated `_0x...` identifiers. The package advertises itself as a Jest configuration preset, a purpose that has no need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or a large opaque script executed at install time. Installing the package via `npm install` automatically fetches an alternate runtime and hands it an unauditable payload on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
